messages:
oliver: Quick follow-up to the recent postmortem — proposal to trial a lightweight 'remediation-escrow' for every postmortem action. Core idea: primary owner + escrow (backup) + explicit expiry + auto-reminders. Keeps ownership visible across handoffs. Thoughts?

naiya: +1. Suggest pairing with priority-based expiry windows: P0 = 72h, P1 = 7d, P2 = 21d. If primary misses expiry, escrow owner becomes primary.

ben: For the tracker card, minimal fields I want: Owner, Escrow owner, Escrow expiry, Priority, Verify-step (link or short checklist), Recurrence tag, Jira/PR link, Blockers. Make verify-step required for closing.

zoe: Add an "IC observer" field so the oncall rotation handoff includes a named reviewer. Observer's job: sanity-check open escrows at shift change and nudge owners. Also, add a small "handoff note" section for the next IC.

oliver: Comms cadence: when escrow created, bot posts 1-line to #eng-oncall + service channel: "Action <id> — owner — ETA — blocker". Then brief progress updates every 72h until closed. Keep it minimal to avoid noise.

oncall-bot: [reminder] Action 2222222222-3 (owner: @ben) due in 24h — pinging escrow @zoe.

ben: Automation idea for recurrence: tag incidents at creation with recurrence keys (e.g., cache-timeout:v2). If same key appears 3x in 45 days, automatically open a "recurrence-review" epic and assign to infra lead + product. Add a short summary line to postmortems: "N occurrences in Xd, likely root: <short>".

naiya: We'll need a small metric to gate closure: e.g., "error_rate < 0.1% over 24h" or specific smoke checks. Require proof (link to dashboard or PR with a canary check).

zoe: For IC rotation, let's add a weekly mini-check in the rotation checklist: "review open escrows >7d". That should reduce forgotten items.

oliver: Proposed pilot scope: infra services only, 3-week pilot. Success metrics: median time-to-close, % actions closed with verification, number of recurring tags surfaced. Pilot steps: (1) ben creates pilot board + card schema (due Fri), (2) zoe updates handoff doc + adds IC-observer line (due Mon), (3) naiya writes SLA tiers + verify checklist template (due Mon), (4) oliver configures bot announcements + reminder cadence (due Tue). Demo after first week to validate.

ben: I'll open a tiny pilot board and webhook for reminders. Will share PR link here when ready.

oncall-bot: [deploy] remediation-escrow-pilot v1 deployed by ben — webhook active.

naia: (typo) naiYa: small note — can we ensure the bot posts aggregate weekly digest to SRE leads with open escrows >7d and recurrence candidates? helps prioritization.

zoe: Good call. Also, let's require a short owner note when marking complete: "verify: <who did what, link>". That makes audits easier.

oliver: Great. If no objections I'll kick off the pilot and schedule a 20-min demo next Wed. Please post one-line updates here during pilot: "Action <id> — owner — status". Goal: fewer lost actions and faster detection of repeat failures. :rocket:
